fields.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
I built my hope on shifting ground
Then heard Your voice and turned around
You spoke a word I could not shake
A promise time could never break

[Pre-Chorus]
So I will stand, I will not run
The work You started is not done

[Chorus]
He who promised is faithful
He who promised is true
Every word You have spoken
Will be finished in You
He who promised is faithful
I will hold to Your name
Yesterday, now, and forever
Jesus, You are the same

[Verse 2]
The years may turn, the seasons fade
Your covenant is not remade
What You have sworn You will complete
The risen Lord still keeps His seat

[Pre-Chorus]
So I will stand, I will not run
The work You started is not done

[Chorus]
He who promised is faithful
He who promised is true
Every word You have spoken
Will be finished in You
He who promised is faithful
I will hold to Your name
Yesterday, now, and forever
Jesus, You are the same

[Bridge]
Not one word falls to the ground
Not one hope left unfound
Yes and amen in Jesus Christ
Every promise, yes and amen
(yes and amen)

[Chorus]
He who promised is faithful
He who promised is true
Every word You have spoken
Will be finished in You
He who promised is faithful
I will hold to Your name
Yesterday, now, and forever
Jesus, You are the same

[Outro]
Jesus, You are the same
(You are the same)
